title: Autonomy common definitions
description: Shared building blocks referenced by every other v0 schema. Not a message on its own.

name.description: Lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens (same rule as edge_server node names).

component_id.description: <kind>:<name>. Identifies a component independent of where it runs, e.g. agent:field-station, adapter:ha.

owner_id.description: owner:root signs registry roots and root-level grants; owner:ops signs day-to-day approvals and grants within limits set by root.

component_ref.description: A component, optionally qualified by the cell it runs on: <kind>:<name>[@<cell>], e.g. svc:action-gateway@field-station. Owner identities are also valid references.

ulid.description: ULID in Crockford base32 (26 characters, no I, L, O, U).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time in UTC with a Z suffix; fractional seconds optional.

signature.description: ed25519:<base64url, unpadded> of a 64-byte Ed25519 signature over the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of the object without its signature field. See spec/README.md#signatures-and-hashes.

public_key.description: ed25519:<base64url, unpadded> of a 32-byte Ed25519 public key.

trust.description: trusted: from a registered component about its own domain. owner: owner-originated. untrusted: derived from external content (web, email, third-party messages, transcripts).

privacy.description: Data classification. Drives model routing (C12) and sync filters (C09).

locality.description: Where a model endpoint runs (ADR-017). cell: this machine. site: this LAN. owned: the owner's machines at other sites, reached only over the owner's private network. cloud: a third party.

routing_privacy.description: Where processing may happen. local_only: never leaves the originating cell. cloud_ok: may use cloud providers or remote workers.

risk_class.description: R0 observe · R1 reversible-local · R2 consequential · R3 never-remote.

correlationid.description: Ties everything belonging to one objective, incident or action story.

dotted_name.description: Lowercase dotted identifier with at least two segments, e.g. ha.helper.set, observation.ha.state_changed.

version_range.description: ^X[.Y[.Z]] (same MAJOR, at least the given version — also for MAJOR 0), ~X.Y[.Z] (same MAJOR.MINOR), or an exact X[.Y[.Z]].

ref.description: Reference to evidence or another record: <scheme>:<id>, e.g. evt:01JC9Q3W..., fact:et0_daily_2026-11-06.
